# Pinterest India

> > Pinterest India: A visual discovery platform featuring creative inspiration across anime art, fashion trends, DIY crafts, and lifestyle ideas tailored for Indian audiences.

Pinterest India (in.pinterest.com) serves as the Indian regional portal of Pinterest, offering curated collections of visual content spanning anime illustrations, hairstyle trends, knitting patterns, condolence imagery, and salon scheduling templates. The platform aggregates ideas from global creators including Brooklyn Tweed, Julie Hoover, and popular anime series like Tokyo Revengers and Bleach.

## Key Topics

- Anime art and manga illustrations
- Black and white sketches
- Character drawing techniques
- Mini drawings and doodles
- Tokyo Revengers characters (Mikey, Manjiro Sano)
- Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo Satoru, Getou Suguru)
- Bob haircuts and 2025 hairstyle trends
- Oversized sweater knitting patterns
- Beauty salon scheduling
- Sympathy and condolence imagery
- Russian-language content
- Beginner-friendly art tutorials
- Fashion designers (Brooklyn Tweed, Gestuz)
- DIY craft projects

## Anime & Manga Art

- [Чб Аниме Рисунки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/чб-аниме-рисунки/912463076083/): Black & white anime drawings featuring Gojo Satoru, Tokyo Revengers, Mikey

## Drawing & Sketching

- [Мини Рисункилегкие](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/мини-рисункилегкие/951037555428/): Easy mini drawings and doodles for beginners and sketch inspiration

## Fashion & Beauty Trends 2025

- [Стрижка Каре 2025](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/стрижка-каре-2025/900691332084/): Bob haircut trends and short hairstyle ideas for 2025
- [Свободные Окошки Март 2025](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/свободные-окошки-март-2025/894059573474/): March 2025 beauty salon appointment scheduling templates for Instagram

## DIY & Crafts

- [Связать Свитер Спицами Оверсайз](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/связать-свитер-спицами-оверсайз/927798993706/): Oversized sweater knitting patterns by Brooklyn Tweed and Julie Hoover

## Lifestyle & Occasions

- [Соболезнования Картинки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/соболезнования-картинки/932638520890/): Condolence images, sympathy cards, and memorial candle pictures
